indications.text: mupirocin ointment 2 % indicated topical treatment impetigo due : staphylococcus aureus streptococcus pyogenes .

contraindications.text: small amount mupirocin ointment applied affected area three times daily . area treated may covered gauze dressing desired . patients showing response within 3 5 days reevaluated .

name: MUPIROCIN
indications_original: Mupirocin ointment 2% is indicated for the topical treatment of impetigo due to: Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcus pyogenes.
contraindications_original: A small amount of mupirocin ointment should be applied to the affected area three times daily. The area treated may be covered with a gauze dressing if desired. Patients not showing a clinical response within 3 to 5 days should be reevaluated.
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Mupirocin Ointment USP, 2% is supplied in 22 gram tubes.
                  Store at 20o to 25oC (68o to 77oF) [See USP Controlled Room Temperature].
